summary.first_pass: Exploratory: one Argus campaign per active family (373). Not a per-manuscript review; a family was marked done once it had accumulated evidence records.

systematic_review.note: Accepted by Argus's own AI Reviewer, not by human experts. Novelty against the literature has not been checked for any item.

lean.checks: Each certificate records exit_code 0, no sorry, no axioms beyond propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound (Lean 4.31.0, Mathlib). 12 recompiled on 2026-11-09: 10 passed, 2 need the OpenAI OAI library on the path.
lean.scope: Each certificate checks a delimited core lemma described in its statement_fidelity.md, not a manuscript end to end. Per-family figures are as of 2026-11-09.
